overview: The Community Development Board recommended approval for a laboratory addition at 200 Boston Avenue and a new eight-unit residential building at 16 Foster Court. Both site plan reviews included detailed conditions regarding landscaping, traffic mitigation, and environmental management.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the July and August 2021 meeting minutes with minor edits and corrections to member titles.

items.title: 200 Boston Avenue Site Plan Review
items.summary: Recommended approval of a downsized three-story research laboratory addition and reduced parking structure, following a presentation by Cummings Properties on project revisions. The recommendation includes conditions for bicycle lane improvements on Boston Avenue, noise-mitigated rooftop equipment, and enhanced landscaping along the property boundaries.

items.title: 16 Foster Court Site Plan Review
items.summary: Recommended approval for a new four-story, eight-unit residential building despite neighborhood concerns regarding height, density, and stormwater runoff. Conditions for the project include the use and maintenance of pervious pavers, preservation of healthy mature trees at the lot line, and a requirement to resolve sidewalk design conflicts with the city engineering department.

items.title: Board Rules and Regulations
items.summary: Tabled the discussion regarding the board's rules and regulations to a future meeting.

items.title: Miscellaneous and Other Updates
items.summary: Received updates on upcoming city council zoning recodification hearings, the Comprehensive Plan schedule, and open positions for city planners.
